title: macOS + Windows: peer-to-peer update propagation
highlights: macOS + Windows: a shared update outbox at ~/Library/Application Support/Entanglo/Updates/ (macOS) and %LocalAppData%\Entanglo\Updates\ (Windows). Any installer dropped there is picked up as an available update, no Netlify round-trip required.

P2P propagation: when the primary peer clicks Install, the installer is streamed to every connected trusted peer over the existing TCP channel before the local install runs. Receivers see a 10-second countdown dialog and can cancel.
Windows: brand-new Files tab — pick a peer, choose a file, watch chunked transfer progress. Backed by the same FileOffer/FileChunk/FileAck protocol the Mac has used since 0.1.30.
Cleanup: on every launch, obsolete Entanglo-<version> installers (older than the running build) are wiped from the outbox and downloads folders to stop storage pile-up across releases.
